component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.contentGrid = m.top.findNode("contentGrid") m.listContainer = m.top.findNode("listContainer") m.video = m.top.findNode("videoPlayer")
' Build and set content node m.contentGrid.content = buildContentList() m.contentGrid.observeField("itemSelected", "onItemSelected")
' Observe video state to exit playback on finish or error m.video.observeField("state", "onVideoState") m.contentGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
function buildContentList() as object listContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode")
' 1. Positional syntax (Overload-style) addItem(listContent, "Big Buck Bunny", "https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/BigBuckBunny.mp4", "mp4", "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/c/c5/Big_buck_bunny_poster_big.jpg/220px-Big_buck_bunny_poster_big.jpg", "A comedic short film about a giant rabbit")
' 2. Single Object / Associative Array syntax addItemFromObject(listContent, { title: "Sintel", url: "https://myvideos.com/sintel.mkv", streamFormat: "mkv", thumbnail: "https://myvideos.com/thumbs/sintel.jpg", description: "A girl searches for her lost dragon" })
' 3. Array of Objects syntax addItems(listContent, [ { title: "Tears of Steel", url: "https://myvideos.com/tears/master.m3u8", streamFormat: "hls", thumbnail: "https://myvideos.com/thumbs/tears.jpg", description: "Sci-fi short by Blender Foundation" }, { title: "Local News Clip", url: "https://myvideos.com/news.mp4", streamFormat: "mp4", thumbnail: "https://myvideos.com/thumbs/news.jpg", description: "Evening news broadcast" } ])
' 4. Raw JSON String syntax (if loading from API or string) jsonSample = "[{""title"": ""Documentary"", ""url"": ""https://myvideos.com/doc.mkv"", ""streamFormat"": ""mkv"", ""thumbnail"": """", ""description"": ""Nature documentary""}]" addItems(listContent, jsonSample)
return listContent end function
' ===== Positional addItem Parameter Support ===== sub addItem(parent as object, title as string, url as string, fmt as string, thumbnail = "" as string, description = "" as string) item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.title = title item.url = url item.streamFormat = fmt item.HDPosterUrl = thumbnail item.description = description parent.appendChild(item) end sub
' ===== Single Object Helper ===== sub addItemFromObject(parent as object, obj as object) if type(obj) <> "roAssociativeArray" then return
item = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") item.title = getString(obj, "title", "Untitled") item.url = getString(obj, "url", "") item.streamFormat = getString(obj, "streamFormat", "mp4") item.HDPosterUrl = getString(obj, "thumbnail", "") item.description = getString(obj, "description", "") parent.appendChild(item) end sub
' ===== Array or JSON String Helper ===== sub addItems(parent as object, itemsInput as dynamic) itemList = invalid
if type(itemsInput) = "roArray" itemList = itemsInput else if type(itemsInput) = "roString" or type(itemsInput) = "String" itemList = ParseJson(itemsInput) end if
if itemList <> invalid and type(itemList) = "roArray" for each obj in itemList addItemFromObject(parent, obj) end for end if end sub
' ===== Safe property lookup with default string value ===== function getString(obj as object, key as string, defaultVal = "" as string) as string if obj.doesExist(key) and obj[key] <> invalid return obj[key].toStr() end if return defaultVal end function
sub onItemSelected(event as object) index = event.getData()[0] * m.contentGrid.numColumns + event.getData()[1] selectedItem = m.contentGrid.content.getChild(index)
videoContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") videoContent.url = selectedItem.url videoContent.title = selectedItem.title videoContent.streamFormat = selectedItem.streamFormat videoContent.HttpCertificatesFile = "common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt"
m.listContainer.visible = false m.video.visible = true m.video.content = videoContent m.video.control = "play" m.video.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onVideoState(event as object) state = event.getData() if state = "finished" or state = "error" returnToList() end if end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" and m.video.visible returnToList() return true end if return false end function
sub returnToList() m.video.control = "stop" m.video.visible = false m.listContainer.visible = true m.contentGrid.setFocus(true) end sub
